QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Lady of the Corrupted Forest
QuestInfo.0: One task remains, to protect Victoria Island from the Black Mage's evil schemes. Go talk to Perzen for the details.
QuestInfo.1: You must defeat Queen Ephenia, who is trying to eradicate all life on Victoria Island.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated Ephenia and prevented Victoria Island from falling into the hands of the Black Mage.

0.0: This will be the last favor we ask of you.\nPlease go to the #r#eQueen's Hiding Place#n#k within the Fairy Forest and #b#edefeat Ephenia#n#k. We cannot allow her to lead Victoria Island into ruin.

yes.0: Beware, for Ephenia has a potent charm ability. I will pray for your success... Our future lies in your hands.

no.0: I know it will be difficult, but this is necessary to safeguard our future. Let me know when you are ready.

yes.0: You have our thanks. The camp is safe, and Athena Pierce is very grateful for everything you have done. Please go see her at the Camp Conference Room. She wishes to give you a token of her gratitude.

mob.0: Ephenia is a dangerous opponent. The longer you wait, the tougher this becomes.
